digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Thursday, September 10 has 10 timed calendar entries, 10 carried-over items, and four urgent priorities. Protect the open morning runway for Amazon Connect escalation and executive follow-up; the day then turns on the noon project-sync and Group 2 UAT collision, the 12% testing completion against today's 45% target, and the 4:00 PM weekly-meeting and Group 3 conflict. The voicemail-routing defect and bilingual-prompt failures are the clearest blockers. Repository state was last modified Monday, so completion status may be stale.

items.detail: Scenario 1 calls are still routing to voicemail, and testing found English and Spanish prompts that do not match the caller's selection. Confirm owners and retest criteria before the noon sync and Group 2 session.

items.label: Drive Amazon Connect UAT to today's checkpoint
